                bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.23

                bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=.55
                bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.29

    mat=bpy.data.materials.new(obj.name+"_surface")
    mat.use_nodes=True
    n=mat.node_tree.nodes
    l=mat.node_tree.links
    bs=n.get("Principled BSDF")
    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=rough
    tex=n.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value=scale
    tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value=4
    tex.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.72

    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(*high,1)

    l.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bs.inputs["Base Color"])

    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=bump_distance
    l.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
    l.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
    obj.data.materials.clear()
    obj.data.materials.append(mat)

for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
    if obj.type=="MESH" and "countertop" in obj.name:
        noise_surface(obj,(.265,.265,.234),(.53,.51,.45),75,.79,.20,.008)
    if obj.type=="MESH" and "plank_" in obj.name:
        mat=obj.data.materials[0]
        mat.use_nodes=True
        n=mat.node_tree.nodes
        l=mat.node_tree.links

        tex=n.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value=4

        mapping=n.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")

        mapping.inputs[1].default_value=(100,3,5)
        l.new(coord.outputs["Generated"],mapping.inputs[0])
        l.new(mapping.outputs["Vector"],tex.inputs["Vector"])
        bump=n.new("ShaderNodeBump")
        bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.14
        bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.006
        l.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
        l.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
        bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.65

world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value=.28
